newsitem.title: UK: UK gilts settle up on Bunds, but off day's high.
newsitem.headline: UK gilts settle up on Bunds, but off day's high.

text.p: UK gilt futures finished the session stronger but off the day's highs, as European markets led the way and traders remained cautious ahead of Thursday's Bank of England Monetary Policy Committee meeting announcement on interest rates.
"It's not been the busiest day and we've gone up on the back of other markets. Really all the impetus has come from the front end of the German market," one trader said.
German Bunds responded well to a bigger-than-expected rise of 17,000 in July's German unemployment figures and traders said the climb in the German market helped to boost gilts.
